entity: Firms under government-wide exclusions receiving new federal awards after the ban
what_we_add: Our specific cut: 23 firms under Reciprocal/Procurement exclusions, about $800K of positive new actions, mostly DoD; GAO's numbers (137 entities, $626M) come from a different, nongeneralizable selection
why: GAO-26-107466 states the same finding in the same direction: entities on the SAM exclusion list got award transactions while excluded. Its much larger totals use a different selection and window, so no contradiction; our 23-firm, DoD-heavy count isn't in any source.
